verdict.rationale: The evidence shows `hatchet worker dev`, which runs a worker locally with hot reload. It does not run the engine or control plane, so it is an adjacent capability. 'Embedded Mode' and self-hosting appear only as page titles or general descriptions, with no evidence that one command starts the whole engine locally. Nothing in the pack documents testing utilities, time skipping, or mocked steps for unit-testing workflows.

support.subject: As a backend developer, one command runs the whole engine locally, and testing utilities let me unit-test workflows with time skipping and mocked steps
